title: Russia’s Central Bank Clears Exchange to Open Bitcoin and Crypto Trading on Nov. 22
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Russia’s Central Bank Clears Exchange to Open Bitcoin and Crypto Trading on Nov. 22 A Bank of Russia ordinance published Wednesday lets exchanges start organized crypto trading on Nov. 22, but only after the central bank approves their rules. Moscow Exchange still aims for Dec. 1. This post Russia’s Central Bank Clears Exchange to Open Bitcoin and Crypto Trading on Nov. 22 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
